en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 2:33 a.m. and later extended it, expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory has a Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 a.m. on Tuesday. The warning was first issued at 2:33 a.m. and has been extended.

Isolated squally thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong. Members of the public are advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid outdoor water sports, and keep away from high ground and highly conductive objects.

Earlier special weather tips noted that rain areas continued to develop near the Pearl River Estuary, bringing heavier showers to parts of the territory in the early morning. Tropical Storm Narra remains distant over the western coast of the Leizhou Peninsula, with a relatively low chance of tropical cyclone warning signals unless it edges closer to the Pearl River Estuary.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至上午8時30分
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨2時33分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至今早8時30分，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台現正發出雷暴警告，有效時間至今日上午8時30分。警告於凌晨2時33分發出，其後延長。
預料香港有局部地區狂風雷暴。市民如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿進行戶外水上活動，亦應避免站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
稍早特別天氣提示指出，珠江口一帶持續有雨區發展，清晨本港部分地區雨勢較大。熱帶風暴紫檀仍於雷州半島西部沿岸一帶，與本港保持相當距離，除非進一步靠近珠江口，否則發出熱帶氣旋警告信號的機會較低。
